time-card-calculator.quickAnswer: Enter clock-in and clock-out times for each day of the week - for example 09:00 to 17:30 Monday to Friday gives 8.5 hours a day, 42.5 hours for the week. With a 40-hour threshold, that is 40 regular hours plus 2.5 overtime hours. Overnight shifts work too: 22:00 to 06:00 counts as 8 hours.
keyFacts: Daily hours = end time minus start time. 09:00 to 17:30 is 8.5 hours.
If the end time is earlier than the start time, the shift is treated as overnight and 24 hours are added.
The weekly total is the simple sum of the seven daily totals.
Overtime = max(0, total minus threshold). The threshold defaults to 40 hours but is adjustable.
Breaks are not deducted automatically - enter times net of breaks, or shorten the shift.
howTo: Set your overtime threshold (default 40 hours per week).
For each day, enter start and end times in 24-hour format.
Leave a day blank for days off.
Read daily hours, the weekly total, regular hours and overtime instantly.
Adjust any time and watch the totals update.
time-card-calculator.formula:
Daily hours = end - start (if end <= start, add 24 h for overnight).
Weekly total = sum of daily hours.
Overtime = max(0, total - threshold).
Regular = total - overtime.
Example: 5 x 8.5 h = 42.5 h; threshold 40 -> overtime = 2.5 h.
time-card-calculator.workedExample:
Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:30; weekend off. Threshold 40.
1. Daily: 17:30 minus 09:00 = 8.5 hours.
2. Five days: 5 x 8.5 = 42.5 hours total.
3. Regular: min(42.5, 40) = 40 hours.
4. Overtime: 42.5 - 40 = 2.5 hours.
5. Saturday and Sunday blank = 0 hours each.

faqs.q: How do I enter an overnight shift?
faqs.a: Just enter it normally, for example 22:00 to 06:00. When the end time is not later than the start, the tool adds 24 hours automatically.
